blind.description: A stylized four-wheeled wooden mine cart reinforced with dark metal bands and rivets. It is filled with a mounded heap of rocky ore or coal featuring mottled dark charcoal, glowing orange, and olive-green mineral patches. It sits on four small metal wheels with hitch/coupler connectors extending from the front and back. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and rendered in a stylized videogame asset aesthetic.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame filled with a rough, bumpy pile of dark ore accented with bright orange and green spots, flanked by small metal hitch hooks extending on the left and right sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 2 feet tall) and about 2.5 to 3 feet long.
